name: IEC photoelectric receiver: normally closed receiver 3 wire with connector
aliases: photoelectric receiver Normally Closed Receiver 3 wire with connector
summary: Photoelectric receiver form: Normally Closed Receiver 3 wire with connector.
description: A photoelectric receiver evaluates light arriving from an associated emitter and provides the documented electrical response. This entry identifies the normally closed receiver 3 wire with connector form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

An object crossing a conveyor beam can change the receiver output. The receiver tag should identify its optical partner and the controller input receiving its signal. The normally-closed designation starts with a conducting output or closed contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The three-wire form distinguishes supply, return and switching output. Confirm sourcing or sinking operation from the actual sensor circuit before connecting it to an input.

The connector variant adds a separable field interface. Keep the mating connector designation, pin numbers and cable-core mapping visible at that boundary. Normally-open and normally-closed labels describe the documented electrical output form. They do not by themselves establish light-on or dark-on operation; confirm that setting with the device data.
